name: Primal Haze
description: Breathe out the oldest haze so that a foe forgets which way is forward.

name: Formless Guard
description: Take no fixed shape at all so that a blow has nothing to land upon.

name: Dissolve Step
description: Dissolve at one point and reform at another a long stride away.

name: Mercy Mist
description: Lay a mercy of first mist on a company of allies and dissolve every taint and curse in them.

name: Boundary Eaten
description: Eat the boundary between a foe and the foe's own technique so that none of it holds.

name: Undefined Phase
description: Become so undefined that no wall or ward can tell the user from open air.

name: Formless Absorb
description: Take any force into the first mist and let it spread until it is nothing.

name: Unfixing
description: Unfix the shape of every foe's stance so that none can plant a foot or raise a hand.

name: Blur Sovereign
description: The sovereign of blur makes the user's place uncertain to every sense with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Unplaced
description: Stand nowhere and everywhere so that no blow finds the user and no barrier holds with a depth that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Edge Erasure
description: Erase the edges of every solid thing across a battlefield so that weapons and walls and warriors lose their shape.

name: Before Form
description: Return a wide ground to the first mist before any shape was drawn from it so that nothing standing there keeps its form.
